Maharashtra Postpones Nanded Gurudwara Act Amendments Amid Sikh Opposition

The Maharashtra government has deferred proposed amendments to the Nanded Gurudwara Act following objections from the Sikh community. The decision to postpone the amendments was made after the community voiced its concerns, leading to the government's reconsideration of the legislative changes.
